messages:
sam: FYI seeing a spike in output-shape rejects on the canary slice for our action-invoke path — dashboard shows ~4x usual rate.
tina: link? :eyes:
sam: https://console.redwood.internal/d/shape-gate?panel=invoke_rejects — most rejects are from a narrow set of routes.
leo: this is the new shape-gating rollout, right? I thought the canary was soft-mode only.
morgan: double-checked: the rollout yaml accidentally set gating.mode=STRICT for canary-2 (50% slice). looks like a flip from yesterday's change.
infra-bot: deploy completed: rollout/shape-gate-canary v2 -> 2026-03-22T22:14Z
tina: ok that explains the bump, but curious why rejects are concentrated on /actions/payments and a couple of partner routes.
sam: dug into sample payloads — payload has enum values that differ. Validator error is an enum mismatch (validator expected 'paid'|'failed' but model returned 'payment_done'). here's an example error and sample response:
```
# validator error
{"path":"$.result.status","error":"enum_mismatch","expected":["paid","failed"],"actual":"payment_done"}

# offending model response
{"result":{"amount":1250,"status":"payment_done","transaction_id":"tx_123"}}
```
leo: ahhh — model variant A still emits legacy enum names. our adapter normally maps those to the canonical enum but I think that mapping was skipped on the streaming path.
leo: mapping we use in adapter (kinda):
```
status_map = {
  "payment_done": "paid",
  "payment_failed": "failed"
}
# apply in adapter.postprocess(response)
```
morgan: proposal: add a telemetry tag to each validation failure indicating whether it occurred before or after adapter mapping (pre-adapter vs post-adapter). that way we can tell if rejects are due to model shape drift vs adapter gaps. also enable per-route example sampling (redact PII) so we can replay.
tina: agreed. also want a tiny dashboard tile that shows fraction of rejects that are auto-fixed by adapters vs hard rejects — that'll help rollback decisions during rollouts.
sam: short-term mitigation: flip canary override to soft-mode for the payment routes only — our rollout system supports route-level overrides.
leo: i'll open a patch to re-enable adapter mapping in the streaming path and add the missing enum mapping. will also add a small unit test for streaming postprocess.
infra-bot: PR 5421 opened by leo: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/PR/5421
morgan: after the PR lands, we should replay sampled rejects through the updated pipeline and update the dashboard pre/post counts. if post-adapter rejects drop to baseline we can re-escalate the strict gating.
tina: thanks — can you also add the telemetry tag to the validation event schema so console can surface pre/post breakdown by route? low effort but high signal.
sam: yep I'll file a small ticket and add it to the rollout rollback checklist
